answer: Charge surge-priced creation fees: when many identities appear at once, the fee for each new identity rises automatically, like a plume of smoke signalling a fire, so a Sybil swarm that tries to wander in by the thousands pays an exploding price per fake while a single honest newcomer pays almost nothing. Fees are burned or paid to victims, so the attacker's cost grows faster than any gain. At the nadir of demand, fees fall back to a tiny baseline, keeping honest entry cheap without ever letting mass creation become free again.
